div.head: II Cn 39.1
div.ab: ⁊ binnon XXX nihton aginne bote ægþer ge wið God ge wið menn be eallum þam þe he age.
⁊ binnan ðrittigum nihtan aginne bote ægðer ge wið Godd ge wið menn be allum þam he age.
Et infra XXX noctes hoc incipiat apud Deum et homines super omne quod habet.
⁊ binnon XXX nihta aginne þa bote ægðer ge wið God ge wið men be eallum ðam ðe he age.
And binnon XXX nihton aginne bote ægþer ge wið God ge wið menn be eallum þam þe he age.
und binnen 30 Nächten beginne er die Busse sowohl vor Kirche wie Staat, bei [Strafe des Verlustes von] allem was er hat.
and within thirty nights let him begin to make amends both to God and to men, on [pain of losing] all that he has.
And he shall begin to make amends both to God and men within 30 days, under pain of forfeiting all that he possesses.
And he is to begin to make amends both to God and to men within 30 days, on pain of losing all that he owns.
And he must start to make amends within thirty days to both God and the community or forfeit all that he owns.
